title: Restock what is still sold
prompt: Set the stock to 20 for every product that has a stock of 0 and is not discontinued. Leave every other product as it is. The starter also restocks discontinued products.
hints: Which products have a stock of 0, and which of those are discontinued?
The WHERE needs a second test, joined with AND.
verify: SELECT id, stock FROM products ORDER BY id;

wrongAnswers.misconception: Leaves out the WHERE, so every product gets a stock of 20.
Restocks every product with less than 20, not only the ones at 0.

feedback: The feedback shows the rows your statement changed. Exactly two products should change, and neither is discontinued.
